# mcp-einvoicing-in

> MCP server for India GST e-invoicing (FORM GST INV-01 schema v1.1 / IRP-IRN), vendor-neutral, GSP-agnostic build

- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-in/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-in/changelog/): version history
- [Contributing](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-in/contributing/): dev setup and PR checklist
- [Security](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-in/security/): vulnerability disclosure policy
